# Pulse Personal 0.8.0

This is an unfinished development branch. Do not claim that 0.8.0 is published
or installable from npm. The current published install remains 0.7.2 until a
separate live acceptance and release.

Pulse is local working memory for Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. The public
package `@zbs-gg/pulse` contains only Personal: no shared-memory server, cloud
synchronization, team command, device key, or shared database is shipped.

Before installation, inspect README.md, AGENTS.md, and
docs/SECURITY_INSTALL_CHECKLIST.md. Explain what will be written and ask for
confirmation.

Normal installation:

    npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@0.7.2 init codex
    pulse doctor
    pulse home

Per-harness preview and confirmation:

    pulse init codex --dry-run
    pulse init claude-code --dry-run
    pulse init cursor --dry-run
    pulse init <harness> --yes
    pulse init <harness> --only <harness>

Trust boundaries:

- memory stays in the local Pulse data directory;
- raw transcript capture and old-chat import are off by default;
- transcript-, secret-, and path-like capsules are rejected;
- no backend model call is enabled by default;
- failure of optional memory must not block terminal, files, Stop/Cancel,
  goal controls, or session completion, and must not create an automatic
  continuation;
- disconnect preserves data; whole-vault wipe requires a separate explicit
  confirmation.
- emotional memory describes one moment, never a personality trait;
- emotional influence halves every 24 hours and stops shaping current context
  after seven days, while the event remains in history;
- raw user quotes and full conversations are not stored with emotional marks;
- one unanswered cause question may appear only in a later ordinary response
  and never creates an automatic continuation.

Official 0.6.7 Personal databases upgrade in place. Databases from unpublished
shared-memory builds are refused without modification.

To merge fragmented local stores without altering them, first run
`pulse migrate local-stores --out local-memory-preview.json --open`. Only real
contradictions need a human choice; commit uses the exact confirmation printed
by Pulse.

The local MCP server uses stdio, supports protocol `2026-07-28` and older
clients, and keeps persistent data in SQLite independently of the connection.

Pulse Team is a separate private pilot. It is not present in this repository
or the npm package. Do not infer that the presence of 0.8 code proves a real
three-person pilot, fresh-session acceptance, or a published emotional-memory
feature.

Status: unfinished development branch, not published or production ready.
